title: Polynomial-Time Computability of a Prime Encoding
statement: For a bit string $z$, let $p(z)$ be the least prime at least $2^{\lceil\log_2(2|z|)\rceil}+1$, and write its binary expansion as a bit string. The function sending $z$ to this expansion is computable in polynomial time.
